found.quote: The library has created a comprehensive guide to AI and its potential uses during your time at Hallam. It highlights good practices and warns about the limitations of AI.
See the Library's guidance about when and how to reference AI.
found.anchor: Acknowledging the use of AI in your work

found.quote: If you have used AI in your work, you need to be clear about whether to reference your use of AI as a source, or to acknowledge your use of AI, or both.
